method: cognition/calibrate_malecns.py: each sensory modality driven identically (150 Hz, 500 ms, 4 seeds) in FlyWire FAFB (published Shiu et al. 2024 model, gain 1) and in the MaleCNS; activity compared over ~7,100 cell types present in both (FlyWire naming, driven types excluded).
choice: highest gain at which no modality runs away (bitter taste runs away from 0.64; head touch from ~0.75)
open_issues: taste and touch loops through the nerve cord run away above gain ~0.64-0.75 (no adaptation or tonic inhibition in the model)
sugar drive to MN9 is ~8x weaker than in the FAFB model
